title: Sightseeing in Egypt: pyramids, Tutankhamen and the Nile
summary: Edison toured historical sites alone, saw the Tutankhamen treasure, and dined on the Nile before the Alexandria concert.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: Well, I often think, you know, when I talk to musicians and they've been to these places and such a lot
Oh, I went everyday. I went -- everyplace I go, I walk.
I think you are a little unusual.

I walk and see all the historical places I can see, you know. And if -- that was a trip I'll never forget, just unforgettable, most invigorating, the most -- oh, it was a trip. It's one time I'm so grateful that I chose music as a career because music, it affords you all the luxuries of life, such as being able to see different historical places that people would never see, you know? That's a luxury to me, to see the pyramids in Egypt, you know?
Well, not too many people get to see them.
The pyramids. Now I saw the treasure of Tutankhamen before it left Egypt.
I went to the Egyptian museum, right behind the Cairo Hilton Hotel. You could walk right out the back and walk right across the street, was the museum, you know? And --
Were any of the other guys in this package interested in that sort of thing?
Well, I would go alone. I couldn't find anybody.
Well, I just wondered whether Benny had --
-- any feeling for that sort of thing.
Oh, yeah. Well, we all had chauffeurs. Yeah, you'd tell your driver to wake you up at a certain time in the morning. He would be there with a car and take you all day, wherever you wanted to go.
Wow. I mean, that's really the VIP thing, isn't it?

Oh, fantastic. And went to Alexandria and played a concert there. That was our last date. Then we had dinner with friends of the ambassador. He had a boat on the Nile, so we had dinner with him. What a thrill, just to be able to have the privilege of just walking to the banks of the Nile, you know? Can you imagine what the Nile -- what memories --
Well, Cleopatra might come down on her barge.
I wish she had. Then I went to see the pyramid of Karnak and the sphinx. Oh, what a trip. Just what a (inaudible).
